row.notes: Frees the old lookup object at self+0x30 and builds a new 0x68-byte one. For each entry of vector +0x40..+0x48 (0x18 bytes: +0 u32 key, +8 resource id) it finds the matching resource in list (*(self+0x18))+8 (0x28 stride), requires it loaded (res+0x28 non-null with +0x70 set; otherwise returns leaving +0x30 null) and inserts key->model into a hash set (FNV-1a over the 4 key bytes). If there are >= 200 entries it also builds a de-duplicated array (obj+0x58, count +0x60, 16-byte items) from every model's +0x70 table. Finally stores at obj+0x64 the max over all models' sub-objects (+0x160..+0x168)->+0x1c8->+0x20 float, floor 1.0. Better context needed: what the u32 key denotes (LOD/variant/part id).
